nodes.name: AI SOAR Alert
nodes.notes: Receives incident events pushed by src/ai_soar/orchestration/n8n.py. Path must match n8n.webhook_path in config/settings.yaml (/webhook/ai-soar). Test it: python -m ai_soar.orchestration.n8n --test --force

nodes.name: Approval Needed?
nodes.notes: Routes on needs_human. Compared as a STRING ('yes'/'no') on purpose: IF-node boolean operations changed names across n8n majors, string equality has not. TRUE branch = a destructive action is held for a human; FALSE = the SOAR already auto-responded. Reads ($json.body || $json) because the Webhook node delivers the payload nested under .body (verified on n8n 2.38); the fallback keeps it working if a future version flattens it.

nodes.name: Format SOC Alert
nodes.notes: Credential-free formatting step. Replace or extend the output, then attach Slack / Gmail / Telegram to the next node. Reads ($json.body || $json) because the Webhook node delivers the payload nested under .body (verified on n8n 2.38); the fallback keeps it working if a future version flattens it.

nodes.name: Notify SOC (attach Slack or Gmail)
nodes.notes: Drop a Slack or Gmail node here and map {{ $json.headline }} / {{ $json.summary }} / {{ $json.approve_url }}. Left as a no-op so the workflow imports with ZERO credentials.

nodes.name: Auto-Response Logged
nodes.notes: Nothing pending: the SOAR already executed the playbook and wrote it to the audit log. Attach a dashboard/ticket node here if you want a record.

nodes.name: SOAR Decision
nodes.notes: Human decision comes back here (Slack button, dashboard, curl). Body: {"incident_id": "INC-XXXX", "decision": "approve" | "dismiss", "approver": "analyst@corp", "reason": "optional"}

nodes.name: Approve or Dismiss?
nodes.notes: Routes on the "decision" field of the incoming body. Reads ($json.body || $json) because the Webhook node delivers the payload nested under .body (verified on n8n 2.38); the fallback keeps it working if a future version flattens it.

nodes.name: POST /incidents/{id}/approve
nodes.notes: Calls the SOAR API. Change the host if the API is not on localhost:8000 (same value as AI_SOAR_API_BASE_URL). Reads ($json.body || $json) because the Webhook node delivers the payload nested under .body (verified on n8n 2.38); the fallback keeps it working if a future version flattens it.

nodes.name: POST /incidents/{id}/dismiss
nodes.notes: Skips the held actions and closes the incident as dismissed. Reads ($json.body || $json) because the Webhook node delivers the payload nested under .body (verified on n8n 2.38); the fallback keeps it working if a future version flattens it.

nodes.name: Decision Applied
nodes.notes: Both branches land here. The SOAR API response contains the updated incident: status, executed actions, approved_by and the audit notes.
